title: Partial-Payment Reduction of the Down-Payment Percentage — Home-Site Lease Training Cases
content:
**Training note: a recent partial payment and the down payment of a Home-Site Lease repayment agreement**

The down-payment percentage of a Home-Site Lease repayment agreement is reduced, in percentage points, according to the latest payment on the lease and the most recent rent charge.

**Rule.** The percentage is reduced by 2.0 points when the latest payment, received on or after the due date of the most recent rent charge, is at least half of that period's rent and occupant charges less credits; by 1.0 point when it is smaller; and not at all when no payment was received on or after that due date. The reduction is subtracted from the down-payment percentage before the percentage is applied.

| Latest payment on the lease | Reduction of the down-payment percentage |
|---|---|
| on or after the due date, at least half of the period's charges less credits | 2.0 points |
| on or after the due date, smaller than that half | 1.0 point |
| none on or after the due date | none |

### Cases (hypothetical period charges of 715.00, half 357.50; down-payment percentage of 20.0 before this reduction)

1. *Latest payment 400.00, received five days after the due date* — 2.0 points: 18.0 percent.
2. *Latest payment 357.50, on the due date* — exactly half: 2.0 points.
3. *Latest payment 200.00, eight days after the due date* — 1.0 point: 19.0 percent.
4. *Latest payment 715.00, two days before the due date* — not on or after the due date: no reduction.

The latest payment is the single most recent payment received on the lease.
